## Summary

Describe the user-visible behavior and why the change is needed.

## Verification

- [ ] Release build succeeds with zero warnings
- [ ] Deterministic tests pass
- [ ] New or changed behavior has focused regression coverage
- [ ] No generated binaries, credentials, account IDs, email addresses, personal paths, or unredacted logs are included
- [ ] User-facing text and public documentation are in English
- [ ] Credential handling and fail-closed switching boundaries are preserved

## Security and privacy impact

Describe any change to authentication files, DPAPI storage, process handling, temporary data, network behavior, or logs. Write `None` when not applicable.
